notes: GIFS NOW ACTUALLY POP. If your PC doesn't have the Microsoft WebView2 runtime, Dezzy was starting an overlay that could never draw - you pressed a GIF and nothing happened, with no error to tell you why. It now uses the simpler built-in overlay instead, which needs nothing installed. And if a pop still can't be shown, Dezzy says so on screen and offers to install WebView2 for you in one click, instead of leaving you guessing. CLOSING REALLY CLOSES. On PCs without WebView2, Dezzy opened in a browser-style window and then kept running after you closed it - it stayed in Task Manager until you ended it by hand. It now shuts down with the window. Closing is quicker everywhere too, so it isn't still listed when you go to look. Adding sounds from a link works again, and so does store search - both were completely broken. Mic + Sounds is always on now and looks after itself: if your mic drops it tells you on screen and comes straight back when you plug it in, and it will never quietly switch you to a different microphone. The voice changer has no on/off switch any more - pick a voice and it's on - and saved voices now fire from a hotkey or a spoken word. Music: queue songs you already have, not just links, plus Clear all and reordering. Also fixed: Dezzy not opening at all on some PCs, freezing after you minimised it, updates deleting files next to the app, the soundboard being almost inaudible, and the purple outline round the loading logo. Won't open with "Failed to load Python DLL"? That's OneDrive emptying the app's files - run "INSTALL - Double-click me first.bat" from the download and it installs Dezzy somewhere OneDrive can't reach.
